sources.description: Josh Norris and Hayden Winks are joined by Matt Harmon to serve up the FIRST Stats vs. Film of the 2026 NFL season. How many times will you hear "Jalen Coker" and "Matthew Golden"? Who is the most Franchise Altering player of the 2026 fantasy season? Get ready for Week 2 with us.
